_source.title: 获取所有快捷键数据
_source.remarks.text.0: 本接口将会获取本扩展的所有快捷键数据
_source.remarks.text.1: 本接口无法获取系统快捷键数据
_source.remarks.text.2: 注意：本接口仅扩展有效，在独立脚本环境内调用将始终 `throw Error`

title: Get all Shortcut key data
remarks.text.0: This API will get all shortcut key data of this extension
remarks.text.1: This API cannot get system shortcut key data
remarks.text.2: Note: This API is only valid for extensions. Calling it in a standalone script environment will always `throw Error`
